items.title: Notice of Filing of Plat of Survey; Massachusetts, Stay Lifted

data.abstract: On November 18, 2019, in the Federal Register, Volume 84, Number 222, on page 63672 a notice titled "Notice of Filing of Plat of Survey; Massachusetts, Stayed" was filed. Said notice referenced the stay of the plat of the dependent resurvey and corrective dependent resurvey of portions of the boundaries of the "Public Settlement Lands" recited in the Act of August 18, 1987, (Pub. L. 100-95) held in trust for the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe, in the Town of Aquinnah, Dukes County, in the State of Massachusetts, accepted April 26, 2019. The protest against the survey was dismissed on February 26, 2026 and the plat of survey was officially filed in Eastern States Office, Falls Church, Virginia on February 27, 2026. items.title: Potency Assurance for Cellular and Gene Therapy Products; Guidance for Industry; Availability

data.abstract: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) is announcing the availability of a final guidance titled "Potency Assurance for Cellular and Gene Therapy Products." The guidance document provides recommendations to help assure the potency of human cellular therapy or gene therapy (CGT) products at all stages of the product lifecycle. FDA is recommending a comprehensive approach to potency assurance of CGT products that is grounded in quality risk management. For investigational products, we describe how to progressively implement a strategy for potency assurance during product development and provide additional considerations to help assure the potency of products that are undergoing rapid clinical development. For licensed products, we describe requirements for potency assurance, including testing required for lot release assays. The guidance announced in this notice finalizes the draft guidance of the same title issued on December 28, 2023.

items.title: List of Approved Spent Fuel Storage Casks: TN Americas, LLC: Standardized NUHOMS® Horizontal Modular Storage System for Irradiated Nuclear Fuel, Certificate of Compliance No. 1004, Renewed Amendment No. 19

data.abstract: The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) is confirming the effective date of November 9, 2026, for the direct final rule that was published in the Federal Register on August 26, 2026. This direct final rule amended the TN Americas, LLC Standardized NUHOMS[supreg] Horizontal Modular Storage System for Irradiated Nuclear Fuel listing within the "List of approved spent fuel storage casks" to include Amendment No. 19 to Certificate of Compliance No. 1004. Amendment No. 19 revises the certificate of compliance to provide for a 61BTH improved basket design using staggered plates similar the 24PTH Type 3 basket approved in CoC 1004 Amendment 18 and similar to the EOS 37PTH and 89BTH baskets approved in CoC 1042. This will simplify construction, reduce weight and improve fabricability. Additional changes are proposed to address editorial corrections, consistency, and terminology clarifications.

items.title: Pipeline Safety: LNG Safety Best Practices Workshop Series Presented by the National Center of Excellence for LNG Safety
tags: Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration

agencies: Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration
data.abstract: The National Center of Excellence for Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Safety (National LNG Center) will host a series of informational workshops on best practices for LNG safety titled, "LNG Safety Best Practices Workshop." The workshops are free; will be hosted in-person with select hybrid sessions offered virtually; and will require advance registration. Each workshop will be a full day and will cover a variety of best practices each session. PHMSA established the National LNG Center in 2023 pursuant to section 111 of the Protecting Our Infrastructure of Pipelines and Enhancing Safety (PIPES) Act of 2020 (Pub. L. 116-260), which directs the National LNG Center to advance Federal LNG expertise, serve as a repository of best practices, and facilitate collaboration among LNG stakeholders. Consistent with this mandate, the workshop series will bring together representatives from industry, government, academia, emergency response organizations, and other stakeholders to promote information sharing and continuous improvement in LNG safety.
